chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who gives birth: is it permissible for her to marry before she becomes pure?
He said: "Yes. But it is not for her husband to consummate the marriage with her until she becomes pure."

key_terms.تَتَزَوَّجَ: to marry or enter into marriage
key_terms.تَطْهُرَ: to become pure from postnatal bleeding
key_terms.يَحِلُّ: becomes permissible according to the law
key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: to consummate the marriage with her
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a woman marry before becoming pure after childbirth in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman after childbirth. It indicates that the marriage contract is permissible before her postnatal bleeding ends, but consummation is not permitted until she attains ritual purity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4445 - Ibn Abi Umair narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):
I asked him about a woman who gives birth, does it become permissible for her to marry before she purifies (from postnatal bleeding)?
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, it is permissible. However, her husband must not consummate the marriage with her until she purifies."
